description: I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds!  I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.
Bring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.
I heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...
completion: You need some Crab Cakes, do you? Well I might be able to cook some up for you...
